title: The King's Favour
text: A letter arrives sealed in black wax that is still wet. The old King thanks your House for its loyalty in the matter of the tax. As a token of his favour he sends a river-cold ring bearing a drowned crown, and writes that he will see you in the Barrows soon.

options.label: Wear the drowned King's ring; a King's favour is a King's favour, drowned or not.

outcomes.text: It fits every finger it is tried on. Whoever wears it is obeyed a little faster than they should be, and dreams of a throne under water.

options.label: Carry the letter to the bishop, and let the Church judge the King's favour.

outcomes.text: The bishop burns it on the altar in a black flame that smells of the river. He blesses your Seat himself, and the city hears of it.

options.label: Burn it unread and never speak of it again.

outcomes.text: It burns slowly. For a week afterward, your Seat's fires burn black for a moment before they catch.
